description:
The /fly HUD speed readout shows 'NaN km/s' for outer-planet destinations (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Ceres, etc.) throughout the entire flight.

Expected: The speed readout should show a realistic heliocentric speed value (km/s) for the spacecraft's current position on the transfer arc, computed via vis-viva using the correct destination-specific Hohmann semi-major axis.

Acceptance criteria:
- heliocentricKms for any outer-planet mission must be a finite number at every scR within the arc range [Earth AU, dest AU]. [code-invariant: Math.sqrt of negative radicand is a crash-level API misuse]
- heliocentricKms for a Jupiter mission (e.g. Galileo, Juno) at departure (scR ≈ R_EARTH_AU) must be within 1.5 km/s of vis-viva on a Earth→Jupiter Hohmann: v ≈ sqrt(4π²·(2/1 − 1/3.1))·4.7404 ≈ 40.1 km/s, where aTransfer = (R_EARTH_AU + DESTINATIONS['jupiter'].a)/2 = (1.0 + 5.20336)/2 ≈ 3.102 AU. [repo-data: static/data/planets.json: Jupiter a=5.20336; lambert-grid.constants.ts DESTINATIONS record]
- heliocentricKms for a Pluto mission (e.g. New Horizons) at departure must NOT use the Mars semi-major axis — the transfer ellipse must be Earth→Pluto: aTransfer = (R_EARTH_AU + DESTINATIONS['pluto'].a)/2. [repo-data: static/data/small-bodies.json: Pluto a=39.482; lambert-grid.constants.ts DESTINATIONS record]
- The existing Mars mission speed readout values must remain unchanged from the pre-fix baseline (vis-viva on Earth-Mars Hohmann). [baseline: Current Mars behaviour is the expected correct window]
- Inner-planet missions (Mercury, Venus) must also produce finite, physically-credible vis-viva values — no NaN, no Infinity, no negative speed. [repo-data: DESTINATIONS record for mercury/venus exist in lambert-grid.constants.ts]

Target: src/routes/fly/+page.svelte — L950-952 heliocentricKms derived computation
Do NOT change heliocentricSpeed() in src/lib/orbital/fly-physics.ts — that function is mathematically correct and needs no change; the bug is at the call site that passes the wrong aTransferAu — it is not the owner of this symptom.
